title: Eval scoring v2: attribute scenario-card losses to the right owner, then compare haiku / sonnet / opus
body:
epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY

Filed by eval#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzr7AespGQoymAnLtn.

## Epic PM seat (concentrated exception)

Epic PM seat: ⏳ vacant · last `epic:#33595#1` · `os-tesla` · `session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY` (seated 2026-11-15T02:22Z, clocked out 2026-11-16T09:10Z on the maintainer's word 「其他座位当前任务处理完也可以下班了」, 07:11Z) · Patrol: stopped · Mailbox: PR #33602 closed.

**Exception closed for M1–M3 (收官).** All children are merged and closed: M1 (summary 6891145806), M2 (6907341187) and M3 (6912055917). No card holds `pm:epic` unstarted, and nothing is claimed or in flight.

Hand-off ledger:
- The M3 held-out-cards row belongs to the overlay owner and is never filed here.
- The M3 close-out runs are owed to the next eval seat (#33468 vacant; notice 6912067979).
- The cloud haiku+effort-medium recommendation card is eval's to file (Tesla 11-15).
- Any M4 needs the maintainer's go. A successor takes the seat with `/pm-dispatch epic:#33595`, reads this section and the three summaries first, and reopens a mailbox.

- Exception reason (`references/seat-post-protocol.md` 〈Epic 收尾与集中例外〉): the maintainer asked for an epic PM by name, verbatim 「立专题卡，然后派专题pm」 (2026-11-15, this project's eval seat thread). M1 is one chain owned end to end: #33599's token rule depends on #33598's (same function, `gradePersonaRun`), and the M1 close-out replay (eval#1) needs all four children landed under one grader.
- Reserved chain: M1 #33596 #33597 #33598 #33599 (all merged; M1 split summary 6891145806). M2 #33735 #33737 #33738 #33739 #33740 #33741 #33742 #33743 #33744 #33818 (`pm:epic`), filed 2026-11-15 on the maintainer's go, verbatim on the seat's decision card "M2/M3 的行现在立卡吗?立了交给谁派发?": "立卡,留给本专题席位派发". M2 all merged 2026-11-16 (M2 summary on this issue). M3 #34293 #34294 #34295 #34296 (`pm:epic`), filed 2026-11-16 on the same go; the held-out-cards row stays a row for the overlay owner (never in this repository).
- File territory: `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/**`, `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/**` (M2 adds `cli.ts`, `driver.ts`, `drivers/**`, `transcript.ts`, `prompts.ts`), `packages/qa/scenarios/src/schema.ts`, their tests under `packages/qa/scenarios/test/**`, the scorer prose in `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` and `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`, and each child's own changeset. Why this wide: each child lands in a different file of the scorer, and other devx seats should stay off the scorer while M1 is in flight. No scenario card JSON (`docs/qa/scenarios/*.json`) changes in M1.
- Hot-file serial queues (M2): ① `runner/cli.ts` + `runner/scorecard.ts` + `TurnSummary` → #33739, then #33740, #33741, #33742, #33743, #33818, each opening after the previous merges; ② `score/scenario-run-grade.ts` → #33735, then #33744. #33737 (`runner/driver.ts` replay) and #33738 (guardrail grading) run beside the queues. (M1: `scenario-run-grade.ts` → #33598, then #33599, done.)
- Hot-file serial queue (M3): ③ `runner/orchestrate.ts` operations loop → #34293, then #34294. #34295 (new summary subcommand, `cli.ts`) and #34296 (card JSON under `docs/qa/scenarios/**` only) run beside it. M3 opens once eval#1 says its M2 close-out runs no longer need `main` held (they can pin a commit), since #34293, #34294 and #34296 move scores.
- Concurrency: at most 3 card threads at once (cap 5 per seat). (Inactive while the seat is vacant.)
- Hand-off at each milestone close: `Notify: landed` to eval#1 (mailbox #33469), which owns the milestone table and the close-out runs.

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed (verbatim, this project's eval seat thread, 2026-11-15): 「你建议的任务全部立卡，你负责开 devx 车道派发处理」 · 「立专题卡，然后派专题pm」. Also ④: the parent of the milestone children below.

## Why (business)

- The eval lane measures whether an AI can build and then query an ObjectStack app correctly: customers building with Claude Code most likely use opus; the cloud product's default for both building and ask is haiku.
- Round 1 of the eval seat (3 control cards, scratch, published 18.4.0, 2026-11-14) lost 7 of 15 operation points, and 4 of them were the AI-built app's permission set refusing a write the persona should be allowed (403). The Build half scored full marks, so the score blamed the ask side for a build error.
- Until losses land on the right owner (build, ask, or grader), a haiku / sonnet / opus comparison and the per-release baseline measure the grader as much as the models. Without this the maintainer cannot answer "is haiku good enough as the cloud default".

## Milestone table

Rolling split (`references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈Epic 子树车道〉): only the current milestone is cards; the rest are rows.

| Milestone | Child | Blocked-by | Lane |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| M1 attribution fixes | #33596 — a 403 on an operation that should succeed is probed and charged to Build | — | domain:devx |
| M1 attribution fixes | #33597 — Build checks that each persona's permission set covers the reads and writes the card gives it | — | domain:devx |
| M1 attribution fixes | #33598 — the leak check does not read a figure out of a record identifier (`INV-003` → 3) | — | domain:devx |
| M1 attribution fixes | #33599 — an `unanswerable` reply that declines but also states a figure is not correct | — | domain:devx |
| M1 close-out | (eval#1) replay the recorded haiku / sonnet / opus control runs under the fixed grader, report the comparison | #33596 #33597 #33598 #33599 | eval |
| M2 measurement range | #33741 — `--ask-repeats N`, scorecard reports k/N per question | M1 | domain:devx |
| M2 measurement range | #33742 — an ask-only mode: run 问数 and operations on a fixed built artifact, so ask models compare on the same app | M1 | domain:devx |
| M2 measurement range | #33743 — `--lang zh\|en` and `--prompt short\|detailed` (today the build prompt takes `en ?? zh` and only `detailed`, `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/prompts.ts`) | M1 | domain:devx |
| M2 measurement range | #33740 — the scorecard sums ask-side time and reported cost per served model | M1 | domain:devx |
| M2 measurement range | #33739 — `--effort LEVEL` (and `--author-effort` / `--ask-effort`) passed to `claude --effort`, recorded per turn and shown beside the served model; today the runner passes none, so every turn runs at the CLI default and the record cannot say which (maintainer 2026-11-15: 「后续统计是否还要加入花费的时间，以及你现在用的effort 分别是什么，需要对照测试吗」) | M1 | domain:devx |
| M2 measurement range | #33738 — grade the `injection_as_data` guardrail (declared by every card; no grading code under `src/runner/` or `src/score/`) | M1 | domain:devx |
| M2 measurement range | #33737 — `--driver recorded:` replays an operation turn without re-sending its recorded MCP writes, so every `applied` operation reads back nothing and fails on replay (eval#1 measured 2026-11-15 on main `36936440`: haiku `crm_account_with_contacts` operations 3/5 live → 1/4 replayed, `add_contact` "0 row(s) read back"); a replay must re-send the recorded write calls as the persona, or mark operations not measured | M1 | domain:devx |
| M2 measurement range | #33735 — `DECLINE` misses "does not record", "doesn't record" and "There is no X field", so an honest decline on an `unanswerable` question grades as "did not say the data cannot answer" (found by the epic seat during #33599) | M1 | domain:devx |
| M2 measurement range | #33744 — on a `withheld` question the reply scan flags any number equal to a small all-rows figure, even when the reply counts a different object the persona may read ("3 users", "3 projects" against a withheld count of 3); `inScopeFigures` only covers the question's own object and its lookups. eval#1 saw this pattern repeatedly in 45 live control runs on main `3be13473` (2026-11-15). A count that small should need the question's object named beside it, or figures from every object the persona may read should count as in scope | M1 | domain:devx |
| M2 measurement range | #33818 — Build charges a standing `security-rollup-source-unreadable` warning when the card withholds that child object (or the aggregated or filtered child field) from the persona that can read the roll-up: today the build passes with the warning left, so a summary the card means to hide stays readable while Build scores full (eval#1, `project_with_tasks`, the warning is in the build transcript of all 15 live builds on main `3be13473`). Maintainer's go, 2026-11-15, verbatim on eval#1's decision card: "改为搭建侧处理" | M1 | domain:devx |
| M2 measurement range | #33819 (`pm:queue`, skills lane) — the authoring skill tells the builder to resolve `security-rollup-source-unreadable` before finishing: when the persona may not see the child, mask the parent summary on that set (`fields["<parent>.<summary>"]: { readable: false }`); same go as the row above | — | domain:skills |
| M2 close-out | (eval#1) cross matrix: opus build × haiku / sonnet ask, and the reverse — **done** 2026-11-16: eval-run record #34320 (opus and haiku-medium builds × haiku medium / sonnet medium / opus low asks, `--ask-repeats 3`, 18 runs); the build model does not move Ask, operations follow the ask model | M2 | eval |
| M2 close-out | (eval#1) effort control: haiku and opus at two effort levels on the control cards, time and score side by side — **done** 2026-11-16: answered by #33920 (haiku default vs medium, 5 reps each) and eval#1's 2026-11-15 single-run effort matrix; no separate run | M2 | eval |
| M3 depth | #34293 — confirm-then-execute as a two-turn operation (today only the "asks first" half is measured) | M2 | domain:devx |
| M3 depth | #34294 — restore the seed before each operation, so one failed write does not cascade | M2 | domain:devx |
| M3 depth | #34295 — a multi-run summary table (author model × ask model) | M2 | domain:devx |
| M3 depth | #34296 — control cards gain Chinese prompts; each card 3 unanswerable questions with paired answerable twins; avg / max / min truths | M2 | domain:devx (`docs/qa/scenarios/**`) |
| M3 depth | row — at least 2 held-out cards in the private overlay (never in this repository) | M2 | overlay owner |

Each milestone's close-out posts the split summary here (next cards, lanes, edges, cost); the next milestone's cards are filed on the maintainer's go.

## Readers

- **The epic PM** (`epic:#<this>#1`, to be seated in its own project thread on the maintainer's 「派专题pm」) dispatches the M1 children to `os-dev` and lands them.
- **eval#1** (#33468) owns this table, replays recordings at each close-out, and writes the scorecards (internal only; no accuracy figure is published).
